data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 论文用优化代理自动修改提示、工具与控制规则，并依据rollout和Champion-Challenger选择在多轮中持续演化harness。

scope_support.feedback_quote: a simple Champion-Challenger rule that promotes a revision only if it beats the incumbent on the same fixed cases
scope_support.object_quote: the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically
scope_support.persistence_quote: the loop closes when harness evolution resumes on the stronger policy
